report_types.name: Incident Report

report_types.description: Formal complaint raised by a student regarding academic or campus issues

report_types.description: Report for incidents of ragging, bullying, or peer harassment

report_types.description: Report for plagiarism, cheating, exam irregularities, or research misconduct

report_types.name: Infrastructure or Facilities Report

report_types.name: Near Miss Report

report_types.description: Report for urgent situations requiring immediate response
